title: Live demo: rich messages to operator via shipped commands
description:
Operator-requested (Peter, 2026-08-16): epic approval includes live demos to his Telegram, sent with the shipped commands (not raw Bot API). Orchestrator-owned tick — no worker; the orchestrator builds tk from the epic branch and runs, in order:
1. tk tell --format with a short MarkdownLite feature summary (bold/code/link visible).
2. tk tell --file with a small document + caption.
3. tk tell --file with a photo (auto-detected kind).
4. tk ask <this-tick> --photo <image> --gate approve --caption "Rich messages demo — approve to sign off" — the operator's tap IS the approval that clears this tick's gate with human provenance.
Any element that fails or renders wrong on the real transport becomes a repair tick before final review.
